learning_outcomes.text: Calculate current, voltage, power, and work in a DC network for an electrical DC circuit.
Correctly apply the following solution methods: Kirchhoff and Thevenin.
Calculate impedance, current, voltage, power, and work in an electrical AC circuit for single-phase and three-phase circuits.
Know the most important protection principles against direct and indirect contact per AC network system in accordance with AREI.
Be able to determine, based on AREI, how certain installation-specific requirements should be implemented/protected.

syllabus_topics: current, voltage, impedance, phase shift, vector diagrams
series circuit, parallel circuit and mixed circuit
three-phase systems: balanced and unbalanced load

assessment_methods.method: Partial or permanent evaluation with exam during the exam period (test after Easter holiday)

assessment_rules: There are 2 evaluation moments: after the Easter holiday (50%) and an exam in the exam period (50%). If the score obtained during the test after the Easter holiday is at least 8/20, the student can keep this score and this subject matter will no longer be questioned. There are no partial transfers for this course unit.
